note: Replay order matters: a reference cannot be created before its target. Ids are minted by the target account, so every step records the OLD id and expects a NEW one to be mapped back.

steps.detail: Upload the two documents in files/. Vapi mints new file ids; keep an old->new map — assistants reference them in model.knowledgeBase.fileIds.

Create the 12 managed tools first: assistants reference them by id in model.toolIds. Re-point each server.url at the new us2 webhook before creating (webhook-repoint.json). THREE MORE tools are inline rather than managed and are created with their parent — see tools-audit.json: a handoff tool inside the squad override, and transferCall + endCall nodes inside the workflow.

Substitute the new tool ids and file ids. Strip id/orgId/createdAt/updatedAt/latestVersion and isServerUrlSecretSet — all are server-assigned. Also re-point assistant-level server URLs: 1 of 15 still targets the old eu2 Make account (NPC Discovery Call Follow Up), 2 already target us2, 11 target the Supabase edge function and need no change. See assistant-server-urls.json.

NPC Sales Force, referencing the 4 new inbound assistant ids. Its member[0] override carries an INLINE handoff tool whose three destination assistantIds must also be remapped — unremapped they point at the old org and the handoff silently fails.
The two Twilio numbers need the Twilio Account SID + auth token supplied again (redacted here). The two vapi-provider numbers are re-provisioned and get NEW SIP URIs.
Re-run the tools audit against the NEW org: every assistant's toolIds must resolve, the squad handoff destinations must name the new assistant ids, and no server.url may contain 'eu2.make.com'.

notPortable: phone numbers themselves — a Twilio number is owned by the Twilio account, not by Vapi; re-point it at the new Vapi org rather than expecting the clone to carry it
vapi-provider numbers get new sipUri values on creation
call history and analytics do not migrate
server URL secrets (isServerUrlSecretSet) are write-only and cannot be read back — none of the 15 NPC assistants sets one, so nothing is lost here
alsoRemap: assistant-level server.url where it points at eu2 (1 assistant)
